messages:
jordan: @here customer (Zephyr Health) sent a model ask — want us to serve calyx-8.7b for summarization + PII-safe redaction. low latency target (<=200ms token p95), prefer int8 if quality holds. asking for rough ETA to be production-ready and any blockers. attaching link to model artifact S3 + tokenizer info.

maria: thanks — can you paste the S3 path and confirm the format? torch .pt or safetensors? also any custom tokenizer or vocab changes? :thinking_face:

jordan: s3://zephyr-models/calyx/v1/model.safetensors and s3://zephyr-models/calyx/v1/tokenizer.json. model is standard transformer; vendor note: uses fused rotary embeddings and a small custom EOS token (ID=50256). they want private deployment (VPC) and audit logs.

sylvia: I can kick off a quick smoke run on dev cluster. plan: (1) load safetensors via hf-compat loader (2) run fp16 baseline, (3) run int8 static quant with llama-quant workflow, compare Rouge/EM and a small prompt set. estimate ~6 hours for initial pass.

dave: FYI we have a limited slot on dedicated-pool-03 this week. are we okay with running quant on dedicated or should we use hosted dev? dedicated will match perf but needs booking.

jordan: they'd prefer dedicated to approximate production. go ahead and reserve 03 for a 12h window. sylvia, can you include the fallback model mapping in the PR (e.g., calyx-8.7b -> calyx-8.7b-quant-int8 and calyx-8.7b-fp16)?

sylvia: yep. quick question on eval set — they provided 200 labeled summaries with redaction labels. want us to include PII-redaction recall as a metric. I suggest adding a manual spot-check of 50 clinical examples.

maria: Agree. Also flagging tokenizer special-case: custom EOS. add mapping in tokenizer config to avoid off-by-one decoding errors. I'll review tokenization unit tests.

quant-bot: [auto] queued job created: job_id=Q-2026-8742 target=node:dedicated-pool-03 image=calyx-smoke:latest steps=fp16,int8

sylvia: starting fp16 load now. if anyone wants logs: tail -f /var/logs/quant/Q-2026-8742.log

dave: reserved dedicated-pool-03 2026-03-24T02:00Z -> 2026-03-24T14:00Z. added ticket INF-4521 and linked to crm:zephyr-42.

jordan: great — next actions: sylvia run smoke + quant, maria add tokenizer tests & redaction metrics, i will prepare customer kickoff doc and SLA notes. ping here when initial numbers are in. :thumbsup:

maria: noted. I'll create PR for tokenizer test vector and a short eval harness in repo ml-evals.

sylvia: fp16 baseline done: p95 latency ~185ms on dedicated with batch=1, memory headroom OK. starting int8 now (running static calibration on 2k calibration tokens). will post results in thread.

sylvia: int8 pass complete: Rouge-L on their 200 examples degraded 0.9 pts, PII-redaction recall unchanged. noun-phrase hallucination slightly up on a 10-sample spot-check. saving artifacts to s3://redwood-internal/quant/Q-2026-8742/. recommending A/B smoke with canary traffic at 5% and close monitoring for hallucination regressions.

jordan: thanks. please file an eval report and open canary config PR with autoscale and fallback mapping. include specific alert thresholds for hallucination increase (>1.5x baseline) and redaction recall drop (>0.5%).

maria: PR #1947 created: tokenizer tests + eval harness. linking INF-4521 -> PR.

sylvia: created eval report: /reports/calyx-8.7b-smoke-2026-03-24.md and PR #1948 for canary routing + fallback. setting canary to 5% with 10 minute windows.

dave: tagging infra to set prod VPC and KMS perms for Zephyr. infra@ here please coordinate.

jordan: closing loop — initial intake complete, next milestone: canary live + 48h watch then rollout. thanks team.
